recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, gritty black-and-white photograph with heavy halftone grain, featuring a primary subject with a guitar in an urban night setting, framed by massive blocky headers and smaller serif subtext in a secondary color.
coreVisualRelationships: Top-heavy dominance of the primary title over the photographic scene
Contrast between the large-scale foreground figure and the smaller mid-ground musician
Juxtaposition of monochromatic photography with a single warm-toned accent color for subtext
Rough, textured borders framing the central photographic action
coreInvariants: Heavy halftone dot pattern throughout the image
Extreme black-and-white contrast with crushed blacks
Tight, overlapping letter spacing in the main header

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large, cropped figure occupies the left foreground; a smaller full-torso musician with a guitar is centered in the mid-ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The massive, black sans-serif title spanning the entire top edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the heavy top title, drops to the large face on the left, follows the guitar neck to the central figure, and ends at the bottom-right subtext.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense and 'packed' with visual information and texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black and white high-contrast halftone photography.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white or cream background for the paper texture.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted orange or terracotta for the secondary subtext.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with zero saturation in the main image; low-saturation warmth in the accent text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold, condensed sans-serif and classic transitional serif.
letterConstructionRules: Header letters must have near-zero tracking (touching or nearly touching)
Vertical terminals on the sans-serif characters
Subtext uses a serif with moderate stroke contrast and bracketed serifs
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'i' dot in the header is a perfect square
The 't' crossbar is short and thick
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme scale contrast between a heavy industrial sans and a traditional serif.
graphicDevices: Rough xerox-style border at the bottom

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, flat-terminal look of the header.
Provides the sturdy, readable serif contrast for the subtext.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photograph of a man with an electric guitar in a blurry urban night street. Apply a heavy 1980s halftone dot filter and xerographic grain. Leave a solid white margin at the top and bottom with rough, distressed edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a massive, condensed black sans-serif title at the top, touching the edges. Add a two-line serif subtitle in the bottom right corner in a muted terracotta orange color.

verificationChecks: Is the halftone grain visible and gritty?
Is the top text massive and tightly spaced?
Is the subtext in a contrasting orange/terracotta color?
Does the image look like a high-contrast photocopy?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of the accent orange
Amount of distressing on the bottom border
mustRedesign: Avoid specific facial features of the original subjects
Do not use the exact brand names or logos
Ensure the guitar is a generic model
postGenerationChecks: Check for halftone artifacts in the highlights
Ensure the black text is deep and solid
Verify the orange text is legible against the dark background
Confirm the composition feels 'crowded' and energetic
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast halftone photography + massive condensed sans-serif header + small serif accent subtext + xerographic distressing.
